subject: Coordinating Novus Retail training — split API + Console slots

Cc: scheduling@novusretail.com

Subject: Re: Training for Novus teams — two-track request

Hi Jonas / Camila,

Thanks again for the overview last week. We have two separate stakeholder groups that would benefit from different focuses: our Platform team (Console + governance) and our Integrations team (API + SDKs). Can we split the enablement into two ~90-minute sessions so each team can be more hands-on?

Target windows (US EST):
- Console walkthrough: Tue Feb 14 — 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- API enablement: Wed Feb 15 — 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

Attendees:
- Platform: Elena Torres (Lead), Marco Jimenez (SRE), April Chen (Security)
- Integrations: Sameera Rao (Lead), Dev team x3 (names to follow)

We also need a short agenda and any preflight checklist so we can ensure environment access is ready. Procurement will need an invoice/PO confirmation before we finalize training if that changes anything on your side — cc'ing procurement.

Appreciate a quick confirmation on times and any materials we should circulate beforehand.

Best,
Elena

Head of Integrations, Novus Retail

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear breakdown. Splitting into two 90-minute sessions makes perfect sense.

Proposed (we can adjust if needed):
- Console walkthrough (90m): Tue Feb 14, 15:00–16:30 EST — overview, demo of org controls, RBAC, and workspace setup; 30 minutes for customer-specific config Q&A.
- API enablement (90m): Wed Feb 15, 09:00–10:30 EST — auth flows, SDK examples, batch/throughput guidance, and a short live test of console-to-API flow.

Attached: novus_training_agenda_v1.pdf (high-level agenda). I'll have Camila lead the API session and Soojin run the Console walkthrough. Camila — can you confirm you can take the API slot 9:00–10:30 on the 15th? Soojin — can you take the Console slot on the 14th at 15:00?

Elena — for preflight, please have:
- One admin user for Console with org-level access and a test project with sample dataset
- OAuth client or API key for the Integrations team (we can give scoped test keys during the call)

I'll send calendar invites once times are confirmed. If Procurement needs an invoice/PO, please share the PO# and we can route to billing (cc procurement).

Thanks,
